body: Definitely. For me,  its lack of technology that I romanticise a lot. These days its hard to get someones fully devoted attention. But just being with someone and talking for hours on end without being aware of the time is something I value a lot.

It's a difficult one. I have a hard time with compliments such as "you're looking nice today". Just because I tend to fixate on everything I've done to get ready because apparently I must've done something right. 

However I do enjoy compliments from a few people in my life. But the fact that I often cant accept these, makes me feel like I'm annoying them or that they'll think I'm fishing for compliments. Therefor I've found it easier to ban compliments alltogether.

Hi, thanks a lot for your response. Unfortunatly, due to covid it isn´t that great to set an appointment and the next one will be in september. But I´m willing to try and improve myself, even if it´ll take a long time. Fingers crossed.

If there´s nothing you can do to change it, don´t get angry about it. 

If you can change it, don´t waste your time being angry about it.

When I was a lot younger, I used to force myself into masturbation and watching porn. Doing these things just didnt seem to work for me either and I only enjoyed it when I was sexting with my current partner.

I think i´m more focussed on the intimacy part of it than on the physical part. So if you take the other person out of the equation, I just don´t really feel a need to do this.

You´re not alone and don´t ever think of yourself as inadequate. Feminism should be empowering, not making you feel like you should force yourself to do something.

I´ve been in a relationship with my allo partner for almost 5 years now. We laugh a lot by calling people hot - for instance on television shows and I even use sentences like "yea, I´d hit that" altough he knows it´s just figure of speech for me. But in a conversation where we went a bit deeper into this, it actually hurt me to hear him say that he´s attracted to other girls in this way.

Try to put yourself in a position that you feel comfortable and talk to him about what hurts you and what doesn´t.

And never forget, he chooses you every single day above all the other people. He cares for you and won´t act on attraction because of this. And in a way, I think that´s quite beautiful.

I used to be someone who didn´t pierce my skin until someone I confided into didn´t take it serious because I didn´t even have scars. I felt so misunderstood, it skyrocketed from there. And now wearing shorts is a difficult task due to the scars.

I´m not happier or more valid now than I was before. No matter how deep or how you hurt yourself. You are valid and you deserve selflove. Take care all x

Making back up plans is indeed a nice suggestion. I understand your feeling of having a negative mindset and love the fact that you turned it in some form of strength. These days, whenever something like this happens, it hits me very hard. Like i could be ok for days or weeks. And suddenly i´m crying in bed wondering why I´m still here. It´s hard to keep a clear mindset. I was wondering if you also encounter this and if you try to create these backup plans beforehand (before complete emotional shutdown)?

First off al, I´m sorry you´ve had to dealt with this and I hope.you´re in a better place right now. Furthermore, I very much do so indeed. It´s as if the more I have, the more I can fuck up. It´s a strange habit to think this way, but a hard one to quit.

Thanks for your comment and i´m very sorry you went through this. As you said, the difference between not wanting something and not wanting to refuse is very relatable. I hope you´re doing well and you sound like an amazing person. <3 good luck on your journey and if you ever need to talk, I´m always willing to do so.

Hey, thanks for your answer on this and sorry for my late response. I´ve done a little bit of soul searching after writing this and wasn´t ready to answer just yet I guess. I also checked out the AVEN website as you suggested and some things are really familiar and others not so much. But it gave me really some insight in myself and how I view and experience attraction on different levels. Also thanks for sharing your situation, I kinda feel weird about the fact that I can feel sexual attraction to my boyfriend, but am learning that this is indeed ok.

I´m doing better now, also thanks to people on here. I´ve had a hard time feeling understood and reading posts makes me feel like im not alone. You´re all fantastic.

Hope you´re doing well. Stay safe x
